Day 1: Capital Xchange Forum, Global Health Exhibition 2026 > Saudi Healthcare Deployment, Market Entry, FDI & PartnershipsPANEL: HealthTech Funding and M&A, From Growth Capital to Strategic ExitsA practical discussion on healthtech funding and M&A activity in 2026 versus 2025, exploring how investors are backing fewer but stronger companies, how AI and tech-enabled care are reshaping value creation, and what founders, operators and investors need to build towards strategic exits.DISCUSSION POINTS• How have funding, valuations and diligence changed since 2025?• Which AI and tech-enabled care models are attracting durable capital?• What milestones make a company strategically ready for acquisition or exit?MODERATORDr. Rana Lonnen: Healthcare and Life Sciences Investor and Advisor, Wyss Center for Bio and NeuroengineeringSPEAKERSLloyd Price: Partner and Co-Founder, Nelson AdvisorsDr. Ibrahim Alnajashi: Chairman, Najashi HoldingMansa Shroff, MBA: Vice President, Healthcare, The CFI GroupSou Miyake, PhD: Head of Venture Investment, Corundum Systems BiologyDr. Elena Lovo: Executive Director and Head of Life Sciences EMEA, Innovation Economy, J.P. Morgan
